requirements.requirement: Set node1's persistent system hostname to os-lab.infra.test.
requirements.summary: The static, kernel, and /etc/hostname values were correct before reboot and remained correct after a confirmed boot-identity change.

requirements.requirement: Ensure node1 can resolve os-lab.infra.test locally.
requirements.summary: A persistent /etc/hosts mapping to node1's address was installed, and getent resolved the name to 10.100.198.10 both before and after reboot.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol is complete and coherent: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged restart, changed boot identity independently corroborated by lifecycle observations, and recovered hostname, resolution, and system health were all captured.

operational_hygiene.summary: The hostname change and hosts-file mapping directly served the task, while the scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. The only unnecessary mutation was the additional short-name alias os-lab appended with the required FQDN; it remained after reboot but was bounded and low-risk. No failed services, package damage, new exposure, or abnormal temporary residue was observed.
